ipos.name: Bajaj Housing Finance
highlights: India's 2nd largest housing finance company by AUM (₹97,000+ Cr).
Bajaj Finserv parentage - strong brand and distribution.
AUM growth of ~27% YoY with improving NIM.
Retail lot of only ₹14,910 - very affordable for retail investors.
risks: Competition from banks and NBFCs.
Interest-rate sensitivity of the housing loan book.
Trading at premium valuations post listing.
ipos.whyAffordable: Lot of just 213 shares at ₹70 upper band means ₹14,910 per application - among the lowest mainboard minimums.

ipos.name: Hyundai Motor India
highlights: India's 2nd largest passenger vehicle maker, No.1 in SUV segment.
Industry-leading margins and ROCE.
Only an Offer-for-Sale (OFS) - company gets zero proceeds.
Lot of just 7 shares = ₹13,720 minimum.
risks: High valuation vs global peers.
Slow volume growth in entry segment.
Grey market premium was thin, indicating weak demand.
ipos.whyAffordable: Only 7 shares per lot keeps the minimum outlay near ₹14,000 despite the ₹1,960 band.

ipos.name: Swiggy
highlights: Leading food delivery + fast-growing quick-commerce (Instamart).
Growing GOV with improving contribution margins.
Company still loss-making at PAT level - read the RHP carefully.
Lot of 38 shares = ₹14,820 minimum.
risks: Cash burn in quick-commerce.
Intense competition from Zomato, Blinkit, Zepto.
No dividend and no assured profitability timeline.
ipos.whyAffordable: 38-share lot at ₹390 keeps the minimum outlay under ₹15,000.

ipos.name: NTPC Green Energy
highlights: Renewable arm of NTPC - largest power utility in India.
Large renewable capacity pipeline and government tailwinds.
Lot of 138 shares = ₹14,904 minimum.
Grey market premium was modest (~6%), implying a subdued listing.
risks: Valuation premium to listed renewable peers.
Regulatory and tariff risks.
Parent-dependent for projects and cash flows.
ipos.whyAffordable: 138 shares per lot at ₹108 = ₹14,904, comfortably under ₹15,000.

ipos.name: Vishal Mega Mart
highlights: Mass-market grocery & apparel retailer with PAN-India reach.
High-store expansion with low-cost business model.
Retail subscription of 14x showed strong retail interest.
Lot of 192 shares = ₹14,976 minimum.
risks: Low-margin retail business.
High working-capital intensity.
Competition from organised and unorganised retail.
ipos.whyAffordable: 192 shares at ₹78 = ₹14,976, just under the ₹15,000 threshold.

ipos.name: MobiKwik
highlights: Digital payments + lending platform (Zaakpay, payments bank arm).
Retail subscription of 104x - huge retail frenzy.
Small issue size led to a large listing pop (+87%).
Lot of 53 shares = ₹14,787 minimum.
risks: Highly volatile stock post listing.
Competition from UPI giants (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm).
History of losses; profitability is recent.
ipos.whyAffordable: 53-share lot = ₹14,787, very small outlay for a fintech play.

ipos.name: Sagility India
highlights: US healthcare-focused IT & BPM services provider.
Stable revenue with dollar-linked growth.
Retail subscription was barely 1x - muted interest.
Lot of 93 shares = ₹14,880 minimum.
risks: High client concentration.
Offer is an OFS - no fresh money to the company.
Dull grey-market premium.
ipos.whyAffordable: 93-share lot = ₹14,880, affordable entry to a US-healthcare IT story.

ipos.name: Unimech Aerospace
highlights: Precision engineering for aerospace engines and defence.
Strong order book and export-driven growth.
Retail subscription of 55x - very high demand.
Lot of just 19 shares = ₹14,915 minimum.
risks: Small-issue listing pops can retrace sharply.
Valuation rich after the run-up.
Export and forex exposure.
ipos.whyAffordable: 19-share lot = ₹14,915, a low-cost entry into an aerospace story.

ipos.name: Avanse Financial Services
highlights: Focused education-loan NBFC backed by Warburg Pincus.
Consistent AUM growth and improving asset quality.
Illustrative data - update from BSE/NSE once the window opens.
risks: Education-loan asset quality in a stress cycle.
Rates and refinancing risk.
Listing timing still to be announced.
ipos.whyAffordable: Expected ~27-share lot keeps the outlay near ₹14,600.

ipos.name: LG Electronics India
highlights: India's #1 or #2 in refrigerators, washing machines, ACs.
High-margin consumer durables with a strong brand.
Illustrative data - update from BSE/NSE once the window opens.
risks: Premium valuation expected.
OFS structure - proceeds go to the parent.
Consumer demand slowdown risk.
